name: AndroidWorld
intro: AndroidWorld在20个真实Android应用上提供116个人工编写的TaskEval任务模板；每个模板用受控随机参数动态生成自然语言目标和初始状态，并通过初始化、成功检查与清理逻辑保证可复现。评测在固定Pixel 6/Android 13环境中运行，主要从文件、数据库和系统设置计算持久功能奖励。
build_method: 人工任务模板构建, 受控随机参数化, 设备状态验证
metric: 任务成功率, 跨随机种子与参数鲁棒性
eval_feature: 在线环境交互, 持久功能奖励, 参数化变体, 可复现设备状态
scale: 20个应用中的116个任务模板，可生成数百万参数化实例
build_method_en: Human-authored task templates, controlled random parameterization, device-state validation
eval_feature_en: Online environment interaction, durable functional rewards, parameterized variants, reproducible device state
intro_en: AndroidWorld provides 116 human-authored TaskEval templates across 20 real Android apps. Each template uses controlled random parameters to dynamically generate a natural-language goal and initial state, with initialization, success checking, and teardown for reproducibility. Evaluation runs on a fixed Pixel 6 / Android 13 environment and derives durable functional rewards primarily from files, databases, and system settings.
scale_en: 116 task templates across 20 apps, yielding millions of parameterized instances
metric_en: Task success rate, robustness across seeds and parameterizations
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2405.14573 Sections 3-5 and the official google-research/android_world repository. The diagram preserves 116 human-authored TaskEval templates across 20 open-source or system apps; offline/no-login/on-device selection; annotator difficulty, category, step, and duration labels; Pixel 6 / Android 13 with fixed app versions and timestamp; seeded parameter generation; initialize/is_successful/teardown; screenshot and accessibility-tree observations; gestures, typing, navigation, and limited function APIs; ADB-backed durable rewards with UI fallback and composite partial rewards; M3A, M3A-Simple, SeeAct, and human success rates; three-seed and same/different-parameter robustness tests; Wilson intervals; and the Pixel 5 / Android 12 cross-check.
